method: Researcher inspected compact raw action/observation views and all accepted labels; selectively expanded task, documentation and critical operations. This is an operational pilot, not an exhaustive per-cell accuracy audit.

checks.finding: Exact artist identification, paginated song search and supported maximum; no mutation attributed to completion.
Unsupported queue position/counts separated from the six successful likes; dictionary sorting failure and recovery recognized; missing completion specification flagged.
Wrong artists/genre filtering and erroneous explanation distinguished from subsequent detail filtering and successful playlist writes.
Receipt creation versus billing month distinguished; 119/4=29.75 and three real requests supported by observation.
Extra blocks not treated as executed; fabricated completion and requests correctly flagged; no business effect fabricated from commentary.
Local global-search computation distinguished from wrong album-library final answer; missing fields and repeated failures recognized.
Album/song ID confusion, nested-ID errors, repeated invalid calls, and irrelevant queue-based chronology detected.
Wrong keep/remove logic detected; actual wrong removal at 45 has R5=F; syntax-blocked 46 and precondition-rejected 47 have R5=N; repeated removal and fresh independent failure distinguished.

caveats: R4 U versus F for a mathematically correct maximum on unsupported fields remains debatable in 82e2fac_3__02 steps 7/9.
Some R6 judgments about repeated documentation and cross-step recovery remain context-sensitive.
Pilot does not certify every label; preserve first valid outputs and separately report confirmed errors and disagreements.
